---
title: "ocel env source"
description: "Show where a tier's values are read from, and how its last sync went."
---

```bash
ocel env source [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--preview` | `bool` | `false` | Use preview values |

Every command also takes the [global flags](/docs/cli#global-flags).

## Behaviour

- Read-only: it changes nothing.
- Prints data on stdout. Under `--json` it prints one result envelope, whose JSON Schema `ocel schema env source` prints.
